# Micah 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Now muster your troops, O daughter of troops; siege is laid against us; with a rod they strike the judge of Israel on the cheek.

**2** But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are too little to be among the clans of Judah, from you shall come forth for Me one who is to be ruler in Israel, whose coming forth is from of old, from ancient days.

**3** Therefore He shall give them up until the time when she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers shall return to the people of Israel.

**4** And He shall stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD His God. And they shall dwell secure, for now He shall be great to the ends of the earth.

**5** And He shall be their peace. When the Assyrian comes into our land and treads in our palaces, then we will raise against him seven shepherds and eight princes of men.

**6** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**7** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**8** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**9** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**10** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**11** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**12** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**13** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**14** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

**15** The remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which delay not for man nor wait for the children of man.

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

- **5:1-2**: The juxtaposition is stunning: Israel's judge is struck on the cheek (v.1), but from tiny Bethlehem comes an eternal ruler (v.2). Present humiliation gives way to cosmic enthronement.

- **5:2**: This verse was central to the magi's quest in Matthew 2:5-6. The chief priests and scribes quote it to locate the Messiah's birthplace — the most consequential interpretation of a Minor Prophet in history.

- **5:4-5**: The ruler is both shepherd and peace personified (ve-hayah zeh shalom — 'this one shall be peace'). Not merely a peacemaker but the embodiment of peace itself.

— LOGOS
